verdict.rationale: Kong's Insomnia/Inso CLI tooling lets teams lint OpenAPI specs (`inso lint spec`) and run test suites (`inso run test`) that could include assertions against live responses, but there's no explicit feature for automated contract-vs-live-response diffing or drift detection tied to the OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: dedicated schema/contract validation of live traffic against the OpenAPI spec, automatic drift alerts, and any hands-on evidence of this workflow being used in practice.
